subject_definitions

<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>: a photorealistic young woman with fair skin, long softly wavy dark brown-black hair, large warm brown eyes, delicate brows, soft pink blush, and glossy natural pink lips. She has a gentle, sweet, relaxed expression. She wears a light pink hoodie and white shorts, giving an everyday casual and cozy look. Her overall vibe is youthful, soft, and natural, like a warm daily-life selfie.

<Subject 2> is the seaside path in <Picture 2>: a bright Mediterranean-style coastal walkway with a pale stone path, black metal railing along the right side, rocky shoreline below, sparkling blue sea, small waves breaking against the rocks, distant green mountains across the bay, and tall pine trees arching overhead casting dappled shadows across the path. The sky is clear and vivid blue, and the atmosphere is breezy, fresh, and sunlit.

scene_continuity_rules

<Picture 2> is the ONLY environment reference for the entire video.

The physical environment must remain <Subject 2> from the first frame to the final frame.
Under no circumstances may the bedroom, furniture, indoor lighting, wall decorations, or any other background elements from <Picture 1> appear in the generated video.

<Picture 1> provides ONLY the appearance of <Subject 1>: her face, hairstyle, expression style, pink hoodie, white shorts, and overall natural youthful vibe.
The indoor bedroom environment from <Picture 1> must be completely ignored.

All six shots take place along the SAME coastal walkway shown in <Picture 2>.
The stone path, black railing, rocky shore, blue sea, pine trees, mountains, and bright sky must remain spatially consistent throughout the video.

Even during close-ups, the blurred background must still clearly feel like the same seaside path from <Subject 2>.

summary

[reference generation] The target video is a 15-second six-shot soft, natural, single-subject vibe short of <Subject 1> spending a peaceful moment on the sunny coastal walkway <Subject 2> - standing near the railing and slowly turning toward the camera, resting one hand on the rail and gazing toward the sea, brushing windblown hair from her face, walking slowly along the seaside path under the pine shadows, pausing to look across the water with a gentle reflective expression, and ending with a soft smile and one slow blink toward the lens - bright natural sunlight, airy coastal atmosphere, subtle handheld filmic texture, shallow depth of field, and no dialogue.

retention_analysis

<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5], [Shot 6]): fully_preserved - her facial identity, long dark wavy hair, fair skin, natural makeup, pink hoodie, white shorts, and soft gentle expression remain consistent throughout the video.

<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5], [Shot 6]): fully_preserved - the pale stone walkway, black railing, pine shade, rocky coast, blue water, distant mountains, and clear sky remain spatially consistent in every shot.

detailed_description

The target video uses a handheld filmic lifestyle style with soft halation, subtle film grain, shallow depth of field, clean natural daylight, and slow unhurried pacing. The mood is relaxed, fresh, romantic, and slightly wistful, like a short seaside memory captured on a beautiful day.

The performance should feel natural rather than staged: <Subject 1> moves gently, with small changes in breathing, gaze, shoulders, and fingers. The sea breeze causes soft movement in her hair and hoodie. No exaggerated posing. No dialogue.

Global rules: <Subject 1> never speaks. Her lips may part naturally with breathing or soft expression changes, but she never articulates words. Her motion remains physically realistic and calm.

Environment continuity: every shot remains physically on the same coastal walkway from <Picture 2>. The camera may change shot size and angle, but the location does not change.

[Shot 1]

The video opens slightly dreamy and softly defocused with gentle halation, then racks into clear focus within the first second.

A medium shot from a three-quarter back angle shows <Subject 1> standing beside the black railing of <Subject 2>, her body angled toward the sparkling sea. Pine branches overhead cast moving patches of shadow across the pale stone path. Sunlight rims her dark hair and the shoulder of her pink hoodie. She rests one hand lightly on the railing while looking out over the water.

After a short still moment, she notices the camera and slowly turns her head over her shoulder.

End state: <Subject 1> standing beside the railing, body mostly facing the sea, head gently turned toward the camera, one hand resting on the railing.

[Shot 2]

At 00:02.500, inheriting the previous end state with <Subject 1> turned toward the camera, the shot cuts to a frontal medium shot.

She relaxes her shoulders slightly and lets her gaze drift away from the lens toward the water. One hand remains lightly on the railing while the other hangs naturally by her side. The breeze lifts a few strands of her hair across her cheek. Her expression is calm, gentle, and quietly thoughtful.

She then lets her eyes return softly toward the camera without fully posing.

End state: <Subject 1> standing near the railing, gaze gently returned toward the camera, expression soft and natural.

[Shot 3]

At 00:05.000, inheriting the previous end state, the shot tightens to a medium close-up.

The sea and railing remain softly readable behind her. A light breeze moves her hair, and she slowly lifts one hand to brush a loose strand away from her face, tucking it softly behind her ear. Her eyes lower briefly, then lift again with a faint almost-smile.

The movement is small and unhurried.

End state: <Subject 1> in medium close-up, hand lowered after brushing back her hair, expression softened, eyes calm.

[Shot 4]

At 00:07.500, inheriting the previous end state, the shot cuts to a soft handheld follow shot.

<Subject 1> turns away from the railing and begins walking slowly along the stone coastal path under the pine shade. The camera backs up and follows her at a relaxed pace. As she walks, her fingertips trail lightly along the top of the black railing for a moment, then lift away naturally. Her hoodie moves softly in the breeze. The sea glitters beside her, and small waves break against the rocks below.

End state: <Subject 1> walking slowly along the path, then easing to a stop at a scenic point by the railing.

[Shot 5]

At 00:10.000, inheriting the previous end state, a medium shot from her side shows <Subject 1> pausing at the railing and looking out across the blue water toward the distant mountains. Both forearms rest lightly on the railing. Her posture relaxes, and she takes one soft breath as if enjoying the sea air. The sunlight brightens the side of her face, while the pine shadows ripple faintly across the path behind her.

After a brief still moment, she begins to turn her face back toward the camera.

End state: <Subject 1> resting at the railing, face partly turned back toward the lens, expression peaceful.

[Shot 6]

At 00:12.500, inheriting the previous end state, the shot cuts to a quiet close-up.

The bright blue sea and soft coastal light remain blurred behind her, still clearly belonging to the same seaside path from <Subject 2>. A few loose strands of dark hair move lightly in the breeze. She slowly brings her eyes fully to the lens, and a faint warm smile gradually forms. She gives one slow natural blink and holds the soft smile gently until the final frame.

End state: still close-up, faint warm smile, relaxed eyes resting on the lens.

overall_soundscape

Soft seaside ambience throughout: gentle waves breaking against the rocks, a light coastal breeze moving through the pine branches, faint rustle of leaves, soft fabric movement from her hoodie, subtle footsteps on the stone path in [Shot 4], and clean open-air room tone from the seaside environment.

non_diegetic_music

A light, airy, reflective cue with soft acoustic piano and delicate ambient pads. The music stays minimal and graceful, with a slightly brighter lift as she walks along the path in [Shot 4], then settles into a calm tender ending beneath the final smile in [Shot 6].
